decisions.reason: Two-component resin injection draws directly on the firm's plural-component dosing and pumping know-how, so it can learn from field results and improve the unit in-house, although its absence from the website in 2020–2021 adds some uncertainty.
It rests on the same core plural-component knowledge, but its overlap with Product A and the lack of website evidence since 2019 make it the more likely candidate if the line is consolidated.

Automatic airless guns are central to the firm's spray application expertise and in-house manufacturing, giving it strong capacity to interpret feedback and refine them, though the earlier withdrawal of the related Product E is a caution.
Manual airless guns are a core accessory tied to the firm's existing pumps and customer base, so feedback is easy to absorb and the product is easy to sustain.
